notes: NEW: CAMPAIGN - FIRST HARVEST. A 12-mission story on the main menu (CAMPAIGN), three weeks before the night Blackwell fell. Checkpoints, the crew fights and talks beside you, 3 hidden STASH TINS per mission, RECRUIT / REGULAR / VETERAN, XP for every mission.

1 LAST DELIVERY: VANTAGE raids the Green Coast Collective - hold the greenhouse, get Mara out, protect the van, CAPTAIN KESS. 2 THE PLUG: photograph the grey boats unseen, find the manifest, catch the fake buyer, snipe from the catwalk.
3 PAPER TRAIL: tail a courier, decrypt the drive, run the metro tunnel. 4 HIGH RISE: silent takedowns on the Lazarus tower, rescue Doc, hold the helipad, THE WARDEN.
5 PURPLE DUST: burn the Nightshade fields, sniper duel with HAWK, beat the dust storm. 6 COLD STORAGE: cut the power, sneak through the dark, break Tank out, steal the seed case.
7 THE PASS: mine the crossings, hit the convoy, protect Tank, THE HOUND. 8 WHEELS UP: meet Sparks, scan the cargo, catch the loader, blow the plane's cargo.
9 THE WORKS: the graveyard, Harold's safe, THE FOREMAN, out through the fire. 10 SOURCE: the Grower's journal, walk him to his lighthouse, burn the first field.
11 LAST STAND: defend the hideout, COMMANDER RHYS. 12 LIGHTS OUT: Blackwell Hospital, HAROLD VOSS and the first infected - leading straight into ZOMBIES chapter one.
CONTACT HIGH: infected bots now kill in one hit up close, like infected players.
ZOMBIES: no more finisher takedowns on zombies (the lock could get you killed in a horde). ZOMBIES LEADERBOARD: best round on any map and games played.
FIX: the traffic lights at VERNON SQUARE were invisible.
